text: If your mail-ballot signature doesn’t match, California throws out your ballot without telling you.

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Vote by Mail
truthSource.oneLine: Signatures are checked. If yours is missing or doesn’t match, your county contacts you and you can fix it by returning a signature verification form by its deadline.

lesson.tip: Signatures really are checked; the false part is “without telling you.” Half-true claims borrow credibility from the true half. Check each part separately.
